column6: and, but, then; the conjunction, written onto the next word
column7:
1) and: joins words, phrases and clauses
2) but, yet: sets one thing against another
3) then, so: carries a story on to its next event, as וַ before the verb
Also written וּ, וַ, וָ.
Examples: וְהָאָרֶץ “and the earth” (Gen 1:2); וַיֹּאמֶר “and he said” (Gen 1:3); תֹהוּ וָבֹהוּ “without form and void” (Gen 1:2).
